children: UK metals recycler's interim revenue more than doubled yr/yr for six months ended June 2026
Profit before tax for the period rose sharply, with improved margins and cost discipline
Company attributes results to UK market growth, stronger metal margins, and PCB services expansion
Company expects Wrexham facility to reach full operational capacity by year end
Majestic sees continued strong demand for critical minerals amid supply deficits
Company says global commodity market volatility and tariffs may increase regional price dislocation
CRITICAL MINERALS DEMAND - Co said strong demand for critical minerals, driven by supply deficits and secondary-supply needs, supported results
SUPPLIER AND CUSTOMER EXPANSION - Majestic expanded supplier and customer base across Asia and Europe through new partnerships
COMMODITY VOLATILITY NAVIGATION - Co said it navigated commodity price volatility and US tariff-driven regional metal dislocations
